baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'they have no capacity over any thing of God's فضل / فضل is in God's hand / He gives it to whom He wills.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Human capacity and possession are bounded, while فضل is both surplus and unowed gift. Placing it in God's owning hand and coupling it to giving by will denies every community both title to the source and jurisdiction over its allocation.

activation_trace.role: Capacity reaching effective action or possession supplies the human jurisdiction that the negation removes.
Increase and remainder make grace an excess that cannot be exhausted by a group's existing share.
Unowed benefaction makes receipt depend on the giver rather than a claimant's entitlement.
The owning hand locates possession and disposal at the divine source.
Giving turns فضل from a static rank into a transferred benefit.
Volition attached to the thing makes distribution responsive to the giver's will, not the recipient's category.

changed_reading.before: A general statement that a scriptural community does not possess God's favor.
changed_reading.after: A denial of allocation rights: no community can enclose, ration, or authorize any portion of a surplus whose ownership and transfer remain with God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The title أهل الكتاب stands as grammatical subject of the denied capacity, while فضل is repeated as rank, gift, and divine possession.
baseline_models.mechanism: A group constituted by belonging to a written corpus can mistake textual custody for qualification, registration, or power to measure rank. The sentence separates affiliation from entitlement: the group can be addressed by its book without becoming the registrar of divine فضل.

activation_trace.role: A community of belonging supplies the corporate identity whose claim is being bounded.
Qualification or fitness exposes the possible slide from being a group to deeming oneself uniquely eligible.
The written corpus supplies the group's explicit marker of affiliation.
Enrollment in a register sharpens the latent mistake of treating membership as a closed allocation list.
Degree and superiority identify the status dimension that a credentialed group might seek to monopolize.
Measurement and deliberative apportionment supply the allocation function denied to the group.

changed_reading.before: People associated with scripture are simply named as an audience lacking favor.
changed_reading.after: Their very markers of belonging and inscription are prevented from becoming credentials that determine who qualifies for divine rank or gift.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The purpose construction leads into يعلم and then the proposition of incapacity.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge is not merely information about فضل; it is disclosure of the knower's own limit. The sentence aims to make a boundary visible: a community may recognize and transmit a sign, yet that recognition does not convert into power over what the sign discloses.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower makes recognition of incapacity the stated epistemic event.
A distinguishing sign lets the verse function as a marker directing the community to its boundary.
A thing's measured limit gives the content of what must become known.
Magnitude and force at the close make the recognized human limit answer to an unbounded divine source.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a theological fact for the community to learn.
changed_reading.after: The learning is reflexive and diagnostic: scripture marks the boundary between knowing about grace and possessing power over it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening assigns universal dominion and effective capacity to God; the focus ending uses the same capacity root and an equally broad 'any thing' construction to deny such reach to the book-community specifically over فضل. The denial is therefore jurisdictional, not a claim that humans can perform no acts at all.

activation_trace.role: Universal sovereignty supplies the positive counterpart to the community's denied allocation authority.
Effective capacity over every thing establishes the divine reach echoed and contrastively negated at 57:29.
The same capacity image anchors the contrast in the focus wording.

structural_cues: 57:2 predicates dominion and capacity over every thing at the surah's opening.
57:29 closes by negating capacity over any thing of فضل for a named human community.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared capacity and 'thing' language at the opening and close; I read the recurrence as a sovereignty contrast. A live alternative is that 57:2 only gives general praise and does not narrowly govern the final negation.

changed_reading.before: The focus sounds like an absolute assertion of human powerlessness.
changed_reading.after: It more precisely denies human jurisdiction over divine distribution by contrasting that limited claim with the surah's opening attribution of universal dominion and capacity to God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's material economy treats wealth as something entrusted to successors, spent out, ultimately inherited by God, and temporarily advanced as a loan that is returned multiplied. Against that economy, فضل in God's hand cannot be private capital owned by a recipient community; receipt creates stewardship and circulation rather than title to the source.

activation_trace.role: The outward movement of wealth supplies circulation rather than retained ownership.
Successive agents standing in another's place make present holders custodial and temporary.
Inheritance returning from prior holders to the ultimate heir dissolves permanent human title.
A cut portion advanced for returned recompense casts possession as a temporary transaction.
Multiplication shows that release from one's share can generate increase rather than depletion.
The focus locates final ownership in God's hand.

structural_cues: 57:7 moves from entrusted succession to spending in one sentence.
57:10 assigns the final inheritance of heavens and earth to God, and 57:11 and 57:18 repeat the loan-and-multiplication exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, spending, inheritance, lending, and multiplication; I connect them as one anti-proprietary economy. They could instead be separate exhortations whose economic images do not directly define فضل.

changed_reading.before: The focus only says that grace belongs to God rather than to the People of the Book.
changed_reading.after: The focus caps a surah-wide stewardship economy: human holders receive, circulate, and return benefits, but no holder acquires proprietary control over the surplus-producing source.

context_deltas.mechanism: Granted light becomes personal motion and orientation: it runs with believers and, in 57:28, enables walking. Others later request a borrowed flame or benefit, but an enclosing wall separates inner mercy from outer punishment. Thus God's giving in 57:29 is not a transferable group credential; grace must be granted in time and embodied as a path, and cannot be appropriated secondhand once the boundary appears.

activation_trace.role: Illumination moving with recipients materializes grace as operative guidance.
Seeking light or benefit from another supplies the failed secondhand-transfer attempt.
An enclosing elevated barrier turns delayed access into spatial exclusion.
Tender mercy names what lies on the accessible interior of the boundary.
A carried allotted share makes mercy personally received rather than inherited as a label.
Walking makes the granted light an enacted route before the final boundary.
The focus verb of giving anchors light and mercy as instances of distributable فضل.

structural_cues: 57:12 places each believer's light before their hands; 57:13 stages a rejected request to take light from them.
The wall in 57:13 separates mercy from punishment, while 57:28 grants mercy and a light by which recipients walk immediately before 57:29.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moving light, attempted borrowing, a mercy boundary, and newly granted walking-light; I infer a temporal rule that received grace must become one's own path before separation. Light could instead denote an outcome parallel to grace rather than a mode of فضل itself.

changed_reading.before: God chooses recipients of an abstract favor.
changed_reading.after: God grants a time-sensitive capacity for illuminated movement: communal labels cannot lend, store, or recover it for someone else after the separating boundary has formed.

context_deltas.mechanism: 57:21 first places the closing formula after a command to race toward forgiveness and a garden as wide as heaven and earth. Its exact فضل-giving-will formula then returns in 57:29. The repetition revises فضل from a scarce status possessed by a community into a divinely opened destination toward which hearers act, while its award still exceeds their control.

activation_trace.role: Racing ahead makes the human response active pursuit rather than control of the prize.
Protective covering of fault gives the repeated فضل formula a concrete salvific horizon.
Unowed benefaction explicitly names the forgiveness-and-garden offer as فضل.
Giving is the repeated transfer verb linking the earlier offer to the focus conclusion.
Divine volition closes the identical allocation clause in the earlier occurrence.
The focus repetition carries that opened horizon into the denial of communal control.

structural_cues: 57:21 immediately identifies its vast promised destination as God's فضل and uses the same giving-by-will close as 57:29.
The first occurrence follows an inclusive imperative to race; the second follows grants to believers and addresses the People of the Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact repeated formula and its first concrete antecedents; I let the first occurrence specify the semantic horizon of the second. The formula could remain a general refrain whose referent shifts in 57:29.

changed_reading.before: فضل is a scarce distinction allocated among competing religious groups.
changed_reading.after: فضل is the vast forgiveness-and-garden horizon opened for pursuit; groups cannot control admission, even though individuals are summoned to race toward it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, book is paired with balance so people rise to equity, then located within a prophetic lineage whose members diverge, and finally contrasted with a self-originated discipline that was not written and was not duly kept. This turns أهل الكتاب from an honorific asset into a custodial audit: possession of a book is validated by enacted measure and care, not by lineage or invented rigor.

activation_trace.role: The transmitted written corpus is an instrument sent with messengers, not a community's private capital.
The balance of justice gives the book an external social function.
Rising with resolve makes people responsible for enacting the measure.
Equity names the public result by which scriptural custody is tested.
Gentle direction to the true path marks only some members of the book-bearing lineage, preventing lineage from guaranteeing response.
Initiating a practice without a prior model supplies the contrast between self-authored rigor and written obligation.
Attentive observance supplies the failed custodial duty, shifting evaluation from possession to care.
The focus title is re-read through demonstrated fitness rather than inherited affiliation.

structural_cues: 57:25 sends book and balance for people to enact equity; 57:26 places prophecy and book in descendants but divides their responses.
57:27 says an innovated discipline was not written for its adherents and that they failed to observe it properly; 57:29 then names أهل الكتاب.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tight book-balance-lineage-innovation-observance sequence; I infer that it audits what makes a community truly fit for its book. The live alternative is that these are separate historical notices and the final title remains merely classificatory.

changed_reading.before: People of the Book possess a credential whose associated فضل is either affirmed or denied.
changed_reading.after: Book-bearing is a public trust measured by equity, guidance, and faithful care; textual or genealogical custody alone grants no authority over God's further gifts.

context_deltas.mechanism: 57:27 grants reward to the faithful among an earlier following, and 57:28 immediately promises two carried portions of mercy to responsive believers. The focus then denies the book-community control over any فضل. The sequence makes distribution additive and cross-group rather than a transfer of one fixed prestige slot: new grants do not cancel earlier faithful receipt, and doubled shares expose the source as non-scarce.

activation_trace.role: Giving both the earlier scripture and the faithful followers' reward establishes receipt within the prior community.
A fresh act of giving continues distribution rather than confiscating the earlier grant.
Two carried shares make multiplication, not mere reassignment, the local allocation image.
Mercy supplies the substance of the doubled shares and links them to فضل.
Surplus in the focus explains how multiple and doubled grants need not be zero-sum.

structural_cues: 57:27 preserves reward for faithful members among the earlier followers.
57:28 adds two portions of mercy for responsive believers, and 57:29 immediately denies communal control of فضل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive grants and an explicit doubled portion; I infer non-scarcity and reject a zero-sum transfer model. A live alternative is that the two portions denote a recipient-specific reward without making a general claim about cross-group abundance.

changed_reading.before: Divine favor is a single rank that passes from one religious community to another.
changed_reading.after: The local sequence portrays favor as additive surplus: faithful receipt can persist across communities while new recipients receive multiplied shares, so no group controls a fixed prestige inventory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence places events in a book before they occur so that people neither collapse over what escapes them nor exult possessively over what arrives, then identifies withholding as a social vice. When 57:29 names أهل الكتاب, 'book' can therefore disclose contingency rather than certify possession: receiving فضل should loosen grief, pride, and hoarding because arrival is gift, not self-authored title.

activation_trace.role: Inscription that fixes an occurrence before its emergence turns book into a disclosure of prior determination.
Failure to reach what has passed supplies the loss-response that inscription is meant to regulate.
Exultant pride supplies the possessive response to receipt that the sequence restrains.
What arrives is explicitly given, preparing the same transfer logic used for فضل in the focus.
Withholding converts possessive emotion into the social behavior opposed by the surah.
The focus community's book-title is anchored back to the preceding function of inscription.

structural_cues: 57:22-23 explicitly gives prior inscription an affective purpose: tempering grief over loss and pride over receipt.
57:24 moves directly from possessive pride to withholding before the final book-history sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, loss, gifted receipt, pride, and withholding in sequence; I infer that this trains the posture expected of any book-bearing community. The alternative is that the cosmic book of 57:22 is categorically distinct from the communal book in 57:29.

changed_reading.before: The title People of the Book marks a textual identity contest over favor.
changed_reading.after: The title also carries an ethical irony: a book should teach contingency and non-possession, so using book-identity to hoard فضل contradicts what inscription was meant to produce.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a watercourse branch of the focus giving-root into a material analogy rather than treating it as the direct lexical sense. It remains anchored in the focus pairing of surplus فضل with God's giving and is reinforced by the packet's rain, revived earth, growth, flowing rivers, and water arriving through a channel. Downstream prose should label it as a hydrological model for distribution, not as a translation claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pairing of surplus فضل with God's hand and the verb of giving can sustain an upstream-source model in which benefit arrives but is not locally owned.

activation_trace.role: Surplus or remainder supplies an overflow available beyond any current holder's portion.
A directed watercourse supplies the exploratory channel by which the upstream gift reaches recipients.
Earth revived through rain and vegetation supplies the effect of received influx.
Rain descending from above supplies the external source that no plot of land controls.
Growth emerging from earth supplies differentiated recipient response to one incoming provision.
Continuous flowing supplies the non-static movement of bestowed benefit.
A river cutting a course through land supplies the destination image for enduring flow.

changed_reading.before: Grace is an item transferred from an owner's hand to selected recipients.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, grace behaves like upstream water: it arrives, revives, grows, and keeps flowing through recipients, while no downstream community can dam, originate, or monopolize its source.

strongest_changes: The exact 57:21 formula makes 57:29's فضل the vast forgiveness-and-garden horizon opened for pursuit, not a scarce communal status.
57:25-27 turn book-bearing into an audited public trust of equity and faithful care rather than a credential controlling further gifts.
57:27-28 preserve earlier faithful reward while adding doubled mercy-shares and walking-light, making divine distribution additive, embodied, and non-zero-sum.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ending gathers several long-range sequences into one compact denial of ownership: opening sovereignty, entrusted wealth, light that cannot be borrowed after a boundary, prior inscription that disciplines possessiveness, and the immediately preceding history of book custody. The repeated فضل formula at 57:21 and the two-share grant at 57:28 were the strongest activators.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic force of the paired negative constructions at the start of 57:29 can affect how directly the purpose clause asserts the community's knowledge.
It remains uncertain whether the light sequence is a mode of فضل itself or a parallel consequence of the same giving.
The cosmic book in 57:22 and communal scripture in 57:25-29 may be deliberately resonant, but their categorical distinction limits the possessive-emotion delta.
The hydrological model is branch-backed and contextually recurrent but remains an analogy, not a lexical rendering.
